item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and structures an emergency board, assigns it investigative and reporting functions, and sets member qualifications; these are internal executive organization measures rather than changes to private legal rights.","evidence":"There is established, effective 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July 25, 2024, a Board composed of a chair and two other members"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The provision limits the Board's performance of its administrative functions according to available funding and does not itself confer funding or dictate a later legal outcome.","evidence":"The Board shall perform its functions subject to the availability of funds."},{"segment_id":"3","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines internal directives requiring the Board to report, maintain records, and terminate with a present, substantive prohibition preventing the disputing parties from changing relevant conditions for 120 days except by agreement.","evidence":"no change in the conditions out of which the dispute arose shall be made by the parties to the controversy, except by agreement of the parties"}]}
